player_prompt.intro:
Rehe Player {player_id} oñeha'arõ jeu Checkers ramo {color}.
Ejuhu mba'e peteĩ chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.j. '[b2c3]' (letra column a–h, row digit 0–7).
Reglas básicas:
  • Mba'e oñondive diagonally forward por 1 si empty.
  • Mba'e ojuka jumping over an opponent piece.
  • Mba'e ha'e Rey si oguata opposite end.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ndaipóri move formato vaerã. Ejuhu [a1b2], e.j. [b2c3].
